pick.headline: Israel and the Vatican agree to establish relations
pick.summary: On December 30, 1993, Israel and the Holy See signed a Fundamental Agreement in Jerusalem leading to full diplomatic relations.
pick.significance: The agreement ended decades of Vatican non-recognition of Israel.
pick.fbis: The Near East & South Asia contents for January 1994 listed "Vatican Representative Signs Recognition Accord" under Israel, with Jordanian and Lebanese reaction, including Fadlallah's criticism.
